notes: net R is modelled locally (apply_frictions slippage on both fills plus commission_r); live rows store gross R only
bar cuts read only --bars-dir; anchor lag is at most 4 calendar days (weekends/holidays included); its close must lie within 25% of its planned entry
alert hour has hour granularity: 09:00-09:29 ET counts as the regular session
every row drawn from this report is exploratory: the window overlaps the 2026 holdout (spec v161 boundary 5)
earnings_proximity: earnings_proximity: days_to_earnings is opportunistic; trades without it are uncovered
fomc_proximity: fomc_proximity: FOMC dates cover 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-08; trades outside are uncovered
macro: CPI and NFP omitted: market_events.py carries no past dates
sector_today: sector_today: today's sector map, not point-in-time
stop cells price the dollar loss at 2% of 10,000 USD
